edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, making the first caller the privileged owner.
msg.sender flows into _owner via initOwner after the onlyFromFactory check.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyFromFactory modifier on initOwner.
init() has no access-control modifier, so any msg.sender can set the controller before owner init.
setOwner is gated by onlyFromModule, which authorizes msg.sender against the modules mapping.
setController is gated by onlyFromModule using msg.sender.
addModule is gated by onlyFromFactoryOrModule checking msg.sender.
removeModule is gated by onlyFromModule checking msg.sender against modules.
bindMethod is gated by onlyFromModule checking msg.sender.
transact is gated by onlyFromFactoryOrModule checking msg.sender.
fallback uses msg.sig to select a bound module and validates modules[module].
addGuardian is gated by onlyWalletModule, which checks Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender).
removeGuardian is gated by onlyWalletModule using msg.sender.
cancelPendingGuardians calls requireWalletModule(msg.sender) once a cancellation occurs.
touchLastActive is gated by onlyWalletModule checking msg.sender.
addToWhitelist is gated by onlyWalletModule checking msg.sender.
logicalSender() returns msg.sender, which is bound as the activating wallet.
UpgraderModule.activate treats msg.sender as the wallet to upgrade with no further validation.
register is gated by onlyManager which checks msg.sender via isManager.
validSince is required to be >= block.timestamp, making guardian activation timestamp dependent.
validUntil is required to be >= block.timestamp in removeGuardian.
setInheritor stores uint64(block.timestamp) as lastActive.
touchLastActiveWhenRequired compares block.timestamp against lastActive plus minInterval.
Effectiveness of a whitelist entry depends on block.timestamp comparison.
block.timestamp drives the linear decay arithmetic of spent quota.
block.timestamp is used as fallback lastActive in inheritance timestamp arithmetic.
transact delegates the low-level dispatch to _call with the supplied mode.
transact performs external calls and relies on the ReentrancyGuard _guardValue flag for protection.
fallback resolves methodToModule[msg.sig] to pick the module to delegate to.
_addModule writes modules[_module] = true after registry validation.
Module.activate() is an untrusted external callback executed during module registration.
removeModule deletes modules[_module] after the deactivate attempt.
try Module(_module).deactivate() performs an external callback before the module is deleted.
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the module via a low-level call that can reenter.
_call executes target.call{value: value}(data) in mode 1 with attacker-influenced target.
_call executes target.delegatecall(data) in mode 2, executing untrusted code in wallet context.
upgradeToAndCall first performs the onlyProxyOwner guarded upgradeTo.
After upgrading, the proxy calls itself with msg.value and arbitrary data.
UpgraderModule.activate adds the configured modules to the wallet.
UpgraderModule.activate removes obsolete modules and finally removes itself.
UpgraderModule.activate triggers the SecurityStore migration.
migrateSecurityStore calls newSecurityStore.addGuardian for each old guardian.
migrateSecurityStore restores the inheritor with a 365 day waiting period.
register first verifies the manager approval signature.
verifyApproval recovers the ECDSA signer and requires it to be a manager.
verifySignature makes a staticcall to an arbitrary contract for ERC1271 wallets.
sendETH performs a low-level ETH transfer with a configurable gas limit.
_spentQuota performs block.timestamp subtraction and proportional decay arithmetic.
_spentQuota uses MathUint.sub for checked subtraction.
reimburseGasFee charges the quota store before transferring the token.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable; guarded by onlyOwner.
claimOwnership reads pendingOwner to authorize the caller.
claimOwnership assigns pendingOwner into owner.
setOwner writes the new owner into _owner.
setController rewrites the controller address used for factory and registry lookups.
bindMethod writes methodToModule[_method] = _module controlling wallet dispatch.
addGuardian mutates wallets[wallet].guardians and guardianIdx.
removeGuardian mutates the guardian status and timestamp in storage.
_cleanRemovedGuardians compacts the guardians array and index mapping.
cancelPendingGuardians rewrites guardian status and timestamps.
touchLastActive writes wallets[wallet].lastActive.
setInheritor writes inheritor, waiting period and lastActive.
touchLastActiveWhenRequired conditionally rewrites lastActive.
addToWhitelist records effectiveTimeMap[wallet][addr].
verifyAndUpdate sets hashes[wallet][hash] = true after wallet-module check.
changeQuota writes currentQuota, pendingQuota and pendingUntil.
checkAndAddToSpent reads and updates the quota record after the module check.
_addToSpent accumulates spentAmount and stamps spentTimestamp.
_initialOwner is validated against address(0) and stored as the wallet owner.
newOwner is validated and written to _owner.
newController is validated and assigned to the controller state variable.
_module is validated by the module registry before being enabled.
mode selects the call semantics inside transact/_call.
to is the destination of the generic wallet transaction.
value is forwarded with the generic wallet transaction.
data is the calldata forwarded by the generic wallet transaction.
to becomes the delegatecall target in mode 2, executing untrusted code in wallet context.
newOwner is stored as the contract owner after validation.
wallet selects the storage entry to modify in addGuardian.
addr is the guardian key written into guardianIdx.
validSince is downcast with toUint64 after the timestamp check.
alwaysOverride controls whether a pending addition timestamp is replaced.
minInternval participates in lastActive plus interval arithmetic.
amount is converted through the price oracle and compared against available quota.
newQuota is range-checked against MAX_QUOTA and downcast with toUint128.
_wallet is part of the approval hash and receives the ENS node.
_label is hashed into the ENS node and used in the approval message.
pos determines whether a new guardian is pushed or an existing one is updated.
success result of _call decides whether transact reverts via assembly.
returnData is bubbled up to the caller and reverted on failure.
module is the resolved implementation that receives the forwarded calldata.

normalization_plan.reason: Initial owner argument flows directly into the owner initialization function.
New owner argument is only meaningful within the setOwner function.
New controller argument is consumed only by setController.
Module address argument is validated and registered inside addModule.
Mode argument selects the call semantics of the transact function.
Destination argument is only used as the transact call target.
Value argument is forwarded by the transact call.
Calldata argument is forwarded by the transact call.
New owner argument is written to the owner state variable in that function.
Wallet argument identifies the storage entry mutated by addGuardian.
Guardian address argument is stored in the guardian index by addGuardian.
validSince argument is compared with block.timestamp and downcast inside addGuardian.
Override flag only controls branching inside addGuardian.
Interval argument participates only in the timestamp arithmetic of that function.
Amount argument is converted and compared against available quota in that function.
Quota argument is range-checked and scheduled by changeQuota.
Wallet argument binds the ENS node owner inside the register flow.
Label argument is hashed to derive the ENS node in register.
Position local is a temporary index derived and consumed entirely within addGuardian.
Success local is a temporary result of _call used only inside transact.
Return-data local is a temporary buffer bubbled up by transact.
Module local is resolved from methodToModule and used only in fallback.
